name: Tessa Tremain
role_zh: 資深總裁級總監，直銷業（亞太）
en: A tower of strength and leadership. He has mentored the entire Asia Pacific group of sales. His skill set is nothing short of extraordinary — organised, talented, multi-lingual, and an overall coordinator of organising a team.
zh: 他是團隊的中流砥柱。他帶領了整個亞太區的銷售團隊。他的能力非凡：高效有序、多才多藝、精通多語，是團隊的全方位核心人物。

name: Car Manuel
en: His strong leadership, strategic thinking, and ability to deliver results are exceptional. His guidance has been invaluable to me. His interpersonal skills and innovative approach make him an essential asset.
zh: 他的領導力、策略思維和執行力都非常出色。他的指導對我來說無比珍貴，他的溝通能力和創新思維讓他成為不可或缺的人才。

name: Elsey Chia
en: His creativity and strategic thinking significantly boosted our marketing efforts and sales. He fostered a collaborative and motivating work environment, empowering his team to reach their full potential.
zh: 他的創造力和策略思維大幅提升了我們的行銷與業績。他打造了一個既團結又充滿動力的工作環境，讓團隊成員都能發揮最大潛力。

name: Arvind Bala Krishnan
en: He possesses a rare ability to foster growth and success by creating an environment that is both supportive and challenging. A person of integrity and unwavering commitment, with an infectious enthusiasm.
zh: 他有一種難得的本事：既給你支持，又推你挑戰。一個正直堅定、熱情有感染力的人。

name: Zulkifli Yusof
role_en: Talent Global Sdn Bhd · Aviation & Aerospace
role_zh: Talent Global Sdn Bhd · 航空與航太
en: A rare blend of insight, empathy, and strategic acumen that sets him apart. His ability to tailor personalized strategies to suit each client's unique needs is a testament to his dedication and proficiency.
zh: 集洞察力、同理心和策略眼光於一身，這讓他與眾不同。他能為每位客戶量身打造策略，充分展現他的用心與專業。

name: Lee Byung-Cheol
en: He has excellent coaching ability and knows how to motivate his team members. He has warm leadership — always praises and leads by servant leadership, encouraging his team to participate and challenge themselves.
zh: 他的教練功力一流，懂得如何帶動團隊。他的領導風格溫暖有力，以鼓勵和身體力行帶頭，激發團隊參與和自我突破。

name: James Loh
en: A true professional. He balances a no-nonsense approach with approachability. His leadership and strategic vision have been consistently impressive.
zh: 不折不扣的專業人士。直來直往，卻依然平易近人。他的領導力和策略眼光始終令人印象深刻。

name: Dyi Wong
role_zh: 行銷經理 · Ngai Seik Leatherwaren
en: A standout professional in MLM. Mikael's dedication and passion are unparalleled. As a speaker, he captivates everyone — when he speaks, people ‘tabik’! A top-notch professional and natural leader. No bluff one!
zh: MLM 行業中的傑出專業人士。Mikael 的投入和熱情無可比擬。作為演講者，他總能抓住全場，他一開口，大家都「tabik」！絕對的頂尖專業，貨真價實。
